vector_set: Canonical NDC v2 Profile 1 — adversarial path and artifact descriptions
authority: WS-NDC-2026-11-24-003 digest 417bd4e5e9904d21d2da5905b3ac68905d677f800526eeedcf25fab897ce2119; Profile 1 Decisions C, D and I
note: All paths are release-relative abstract strings. No filesystem operation is performed by the workspace checker, and no external observation is represented.

cases.rule: No traversal component, no rooted path and no duplicate normalized path.

cases.descriptor_condition: the published regular file is replaced by a symbolic link to an abstract target named outside-target
cases.rule: Descriptors are opened without following symbolic links; only regular files are admitted.

cases.descriptor_condition: the declared artifact is absent from the published artifact set
cases.rule: The published file set must equal the set derived from the sole inventory.

cases.descriptor_condition: an additional file not listed in artifacts[] is present in the release
cases.rule: An exact file set is verified; an extra file fails closed.

cases.descriptor_condition: two descriptors declare the same logical_partition_id and shard_ordinal
cases.rule: The pair is unique and defines canonical artifact order.
Duplicate keys with conflicting payloads are rejected; a caller-supplied pre-sorted hint is not trusted.
Only registered string compression identifiers are admitted; no inference from magic bytes or extension.

cases.descriptor_condition: the declared data_sha256 does not equal the SHA-256 of the concatenated uncompressed canonical streams in artifact order
cases.rule: The dataset digest is over uncompressed canonical streams and is independent of compression.
